args.title: Fix password reset email URL to use a production BASE_URL
args.body: Issue 4201 reports that the password reset email links to the localhost URL, making it impossible for users outside the development environment to access the reset password page. This change will modify the BASE_URL in src/notifications/templates.ts to ensure that the password reset email uses the correct production URL instead of `http://localhost:3000`. The modified link will ensure proper connectivity for all users.
